thread:
sam: Quick follow-up from the SSO auth postmortem — starting a probabilistic pager pruning effort to cut down repeat pages. Goal: reduce noise while keeping signal.

tanya: +1. Can you list owners and short deadlines? I can take thresholds/quiet-hours.

sam: Draft actions:
1) Inventory top noisy alerts (miguel) — 3d
2) Prototype probabilistic dedupe (sam) — 1w
3) Threshold smoothing & night suppression (tanya) — 5d
4) Canary rollout plan + monitoring (lee) — 2w
I'll add these to the remediation board.

miguel: On it. I'll run a quick query and post the top-ten noisy alerts.

miguel: Results (quick paste):
```
1 kvcache-miss-rate (infra)
2 token-service-4xx-burst (app)
3 auth-db-timeout
4 cert-renewal-failure (infra)
5 queue-depth-spike (ingest)
6 model-oom-events (runtime)
7 metric-emit-lag (telemetry)
8 webhook-429-burst (external)
9 plugin-reload-fail (platform)
10 redis-slowlog-avg
```
I'll attach counts and recent pages on the board.

tanya: For thresholds I'm leaning percentile smoothing instead of hard counts. Example rule I want to try for kvcache:
```
alert if p95 > 120ms for 5m AND rate(p95, 15m) > 2x baseline
night_suppression: mute 23:00-06:00 unless p99 > 500ms
```
Thoughts?

lee: Sounds sensible. For rollouts I'd like a staged canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback on page regression (>5 pages/hour).

sam: Important note: probabilistic dedupe should not drop the first unique context that indicates a new class of failure. Plan is to dedupe only exact-duplicate fingerprints for N minutes with probability p (starting p=0.7). We'll iterate.

tanya: :eyes: Agree on conservative start. Also propose a dashboard metric: pages-per-1000-alerts + missed-major-incidents (false-suppression counter).

ops-bot: remediation-board: card created -> https://org.kanban/PRUNING-42 (owner tags: miguel,tanya,sam,lee)

miguel: I'll push my CSV with counts and a short notebook to the board by EOD.

sam: Next check-in: Friday 10:00am PST. If anyone needs an earlier sync ping here. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lee: ack. I'll draft the canary playbook and include rollback telemetry hooks.

tanya: I'll post threshold PRs and night-suppression RFC in the docs channel for feedback.

sam: Great — tracking on the board. Closing this thread for ad-hoc noise; reopen if blockers.
